purpose: Freeze the NEW Route/Hosted QA Hosted Gate after default-branch workflow integration, authoritative GitHub Pages deployment of the exact source SHA, and a read-only STRICT_CANDIDATE proof with all frozen Hosted checks passing. Preserve the RH3 clean-room runtime and keep Browser/UI, semantic, frontend, asset, deployment-writer, Status Source, and OLD Project Doctor authority outside RH4.

reviews.detail: Authoritative deploy run 33379752457 attempt 1 published successfully but job 99449184214 failed at Verify actual hosted composed surface. Exactly one rerun of the failed deploy-and-verify job was performed. Attempt 2 job 99451773692 passed the same hosted verification and the workflow concluded success, so the initial failure was not reproduced and is not classified as an RH4 regression.

The authoritative Pages deploy workflow remains the deployment-owning writer. The NEW RH4 workflow only consumes its successful completion event and exact head SHA with contents:read permission; RH4 does not inherit deployment writer authority.
RH4 completes the HTTP Hosted Gate only. Browser/Playwright interaction remains the next separate Browser/UI validation stage and must not reopen the completed Hosted semantic or runtime boundary.
Any remaining Status Source rollback cleanup or live dispatch mutation proof belongs to the separate Status Source owning scope and does not block or reopen RH4 Hosted Gate completion.

nonScope: No semantic, canonical, relation, ConfigData, localization, frontend, or asset data is changed by the RH4 freeze.
No Browser/UI or Playwright runtime is added to the NEW Route/Hosted QA workflow.
No gh-pages write, repository writer, force-push, Status Source writer, or Project Status writer is added to the NEW Route/Hosted QA workflow.
No strict freshness assertion is bypassed, weakened, or converted to a probe result.
No OLD Project Doctor runtime is made authoritative for NEW RH4 Route/Hosted QA execution.
nextStart: Run required project-check on the RH4 freeze commit. If changed-path ownership resolves this checkpoint to route-hosted-qa-self-test and the required Project Check passes, classify RH4 as COMPLETE / HOSTED GATE PASS. Then begin the separate Browser/UI interaction stage without reopening RH3 or RH4 unless an explicit reopen condition is met.
reopenConditions: The RH3 implementation or RH4 workflow-integration predecessor no longer satisfies its frozen completion requirements.
The authoritative hosted target, repository base, route fixtures, hosted check IDs, strict expected-SHA strategy, or default-branch workflow trigger contract changes.
The route-hosted-qa owner no longer resolves RH4 paths to the dedicated route-hosted-qa-self-test validator.
Authoritative evidence shows the NEW RH4 workflow mutates repository or deployment state, launches Browser/Playwright runtime, or depends on OLD Project Doctor runtime authority.
A current-branch-only Project Check failure is causally owned by the RH4 freeze checkpoint or RH4 integration.
A legitimate strict-candidate rerun against the same unchanged deployed source reproduces a Hosted Gate failure.
Hosted, Browser/UI, semantic, frontend, asset, deployment-writer, or Status Source ownership boundaries change.
